race.description: Tab We're On Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: WINTER HAIL (2) was an effortless maiden winner when resuming last time out over 1000m at Narrandera, scoring by 3.5 lengths. Loy sticks from a tricky draw but he looks more than capable of taking the next step. NOTEABEEL (3) disappointed last time at the Sapphire Coast after a close second at Wagga the run prior. Warrants another look. WITCH OF NOVEMBER (8) progressed nicely last time out to finish second at Wagga. Looks to be in the right race so she should be in contention again. NEFRADITE (4) returns and while she hasn't been seen at any public trials in readiness the form around her stacks right up for a race of this depth. Gets in light with the 3kg claim and is another to consider.
